lan.error.unreachable: Cannot connect to the other device. Ensure both devices are connected to the same Wi‑Fi. Corporate, school, or hotel networks may block device-to-device connections; try using a mobile hotspot instead.
lan.error.expired: The QR code has expired. Please display the QR code again on the other device and scan once more.
lan.error.invalidLink: Invalid connection info. Please scan again, or copy the complete connection info and paste it.
lan.error.invalidData: The transferred data is incomplete. Please reconnect and try again.
lan.error.busy: Another import or export is in progress. Please wait for it to complete.
lan.error.network: Network connection was interrupted. Ensure both devices are connected to the same Wi‑Fi, then reconnect.
lan.error.secure: Could not establish a secure connection. Please display the QR code again on the other device and retry.
lan.error.readBooks: Error reading books to send. Please ensure the book files are still in their original location.
lan.error.save: Error saving data. Please ensure the device has sufficient storage space.
lan.error.spaceSend: Insufficient storage space to prepare this transfer. Please free up space or select fewer books.
lan.error.spaceReceive: Insufficient storage space to receive this transfer. Free up space and reconnect, or ask the sender to select fewer books.
lan.error.metadataTooLarge: Too much reading data for this transfer. Please select fewer books and transfer in batches.
lan.error.protocol: Both devices must be updated to a version that supports the same transfer protocol.
lan.error.ended: The connection has ended. Please reconnect.
lan.error.unsupported: Device transfer is not supported on this device.
lan.error.generic: Transfer did not complete. Please reconnect and try again.
lan.scan.permission: Camera permission is required to scan QR codes. You can enable camera access in system settings, or choose "Paste connection info".
lan.scan.noCamera: No camera available on this device. Please choose "Paste connection info".
lan.scan.cameraError: Camera is temporarily unavailable, possibly in use by another app. Please try again later or choose "Paste connection info".
lan.scan.failed: Unable to open QR code scanner. Please choose "Paste connection info".
lan.offer.books.other: The other device wants to send reading data for {count} books
lan.offer.books.one: The other device wants to send reading data for {count} book
lan.offer.settings: The other device wants to send reading settings
lan.offer.dataOnly: Includes reading progress, bookmarks, and notes only ({size} in total).
lan.offer.skipped: ; {count} books have no available files, syncing data only
lan.notice.committing: Commit has started; closing the window will not roll back.
lan.notice.connected: Connected: you can send data or wait for the other device to send.
lan.notice.endedWaiting: Connection ended, waiting for local results.
lan.notice.pasteFirst: Please paste the complete connection info first.
lan.notice.peerImported: The other device has imported the data.
lan.notice.peerUnconfirmed: Connection ended; import confirmation from the other device was not received.
